remarks:
There is a 2-acre building lot at the Southeast corner of Westbrook Road & Clinton Street Road (Rt. 33).

The remaining acreage is gorgeous land with terrific topography that has Black Creek running through it. This portion of the property is a protected wetland area that is in the 'Great Lakes Restoration Initiative" there are some limitations that run with this protection, as in there will no building or modifications to the land area within the protested boundaries.

You can build a home or hunt to your heart's content!
